name.en: Duel Domination Get Ready for War! The Enforcers!
name.ja: Duel Domination 満足しようぜ！チーム・サティスファクション！

notes: There are two main methods of earning rewards from this event: rewards earned through conquering Areas on each Map, and rewards received from the Event Lottery.

The following rewards could be earned by conquering Areas on each Map. A Map is considered "Cleared" once the player has defeated all of its Boss Duelists at least once. However, the player can receive additional rewards by conquering every Area in a given Map.

path: Map 1: Get Ready for War! The Enforcers!
notes: This Map was available from the start of the event.
While traversing this Map, the player can use the EX Skill Domination Power: Light.

path: Map 1: Get Ready for War! The Enforcers!
notes: Duel Areas
Treasure Rooms
Defeating all Boss Duelists in this Map unlocks the Alt Style Yusei Fudo (The Enforcers) for the player to use.
Conquering all Areas on this Map rewards the player with Card Sleeves: Yusei Fudo (The Enforcers) & Jack Atlas (The Enforcers).

path: Map 1: Get Ready for War! The Enforcers!
notes: Duel Areas
Treasure Rooms
Defeating all Boss Duelists in this Map unlocks the Alt Style Crow Hogan (The Enforcers) for the player to use.
Conquering all Areas on this Map rewards the player with Card Sleeves: Crow Hogan (The Enforcers) & Kalin Kessler (The Enforcers).

path: Map 2: We Still Want More! The Enforcers!
notes: This Map became available on May 21, 2026.
While traversing this Map, the player can use the EX Skill Domination Power: Soul during the first run of the event, and the EX Skill Domination Power: Whirlwind during the second run.

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
